notes.title: Spring cosmetics update
notes.content:
Updated customization UI with more options 
We have updated the customization UI and made it possible to select different color variations to each wearable item.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957448/a54822574411fb4a2eb869a5611ef8ca8c1311ae.jpg

 Outfit spotlight: Hennin cones + suit 
This spring we have a fabulous addition to your wardrobe, a fabulous pyjamas with inspiration from the medieval times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957448/83c3a7063300946860b20b65c9c1b2eefa1a5159.jpg

 New furniture: The Yoga Horse 
The Yoga Horse is our latest mountable addition. Please try it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957448/218fd4795dd9cc16c75be5c9f5e0f505a65d2985.jpg

Why not enjoy it in latex?

https://i.imgur.com/et7ka5P.gif

 No suit! 
We have made it possible to remove the suit. The plan is to add more underwear options in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957448/e04432b00f8b96fa30f20f6e02348a46e09c22dd.jpg

 Whistling 
You can now whistle as a way of communicating with other players. It might just mean "that outfit is hot!" or perhaps "please, look over here!". The default key-binding for whistling is R.

 FSR3 support 
FSR3 is an upscaling technique supported by most newer graphics cards. You can choose between Quality/Balanced/Performance in the graphics menus.

 Feedback wanted 
We have a lot of interesting ideas for our next update. But we would love input, so please write to us here if you want to help improve the game:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2872120/discussions/0/4363500699218582960/

 Full release notes 
 Bug fixes 

 Various animation fixes
 Eyebrows and moustasches are now visible on characters
 Fixed issue with hair material not being set
 Toilets now have toilet rings!

 New features and furniture

 Reworked wearable item menu
 You can now change the color of each wearable item
 Added whistling
 Added FSR3 support
 Added wave animation
 Clothes hanger
 Yoga chair

New wearable items

 You can now wear underwear instead of a suit
 Elbow gloves
 Lower harness
 Upper harness
 Hennin cones + matching suit

New emotes

 Wave
 2 new dances

notes.title: 0.1.150: Suit color options and fireplace
notes.content:
New:

* It is now possible to select different suits. To start off with, these are the ones available: black, white and red

* Added fireplace, you add logs to the fire to make it burn

* You can now dance in some of the cages

We removed the holidays decorations, they will be back in the end of the year :)

Fixes:

* Fixed bug which made other players spin while they were emoting

* Texture optimizations

notes.title: 0.1.119: Holidays and more!
notes.content:
New:


 Added new sitting system – you can now sit together in a more intimate way

 Added holiday theme: santa suit, santa hat, christmas tree and cookies!

 Added pillows that you can pick up and throw

 Added bottle you can pick up and drink from

 Added new furniture; the love seat and the futon

 Reworked the club dance floor

 Added new emote: / lie which makes you chill in the floor


Fixes:


 Cut the installation/download size to 50% by optimising textures

 Improved dance animations

 Improved lighting

 Various performance fixes


Known issues:


 Unfortunately all eyebrows and moustaches has stopped working

notes.title: 0.1.8: More bug fixes and tweaks!
notes.content:
* Reworked all movement animations to make them more realistic looking

* Fixed bug where the mouse cursors disappeared when opening the pause menu whilst in the closet

* Using esc when the chat is open will now close the chat

* Added game icon

* Fixed song loop issue

* Removed interactive beer glass because it is glitchy and will be re-added in a future update

notes.title: 0.1.4: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed very slow walking speed + animations

* Fixed issue where the audio of some interactive items could not be heard
